propositions: The dev bootstrap (Makefile install and install-unlocked targets) must explicitly name the metrics extra to pin the toolchain intent independently of CI-motivated self-reference, preventing accidental regression if the dev extra self-reference is ever trimmed.
Non-Python analyzers scc (Go) and jscpd (Node) cannot be installed via Python extras and require documented manual install steps using brew and npm respectively.
Absence of scc or jscpd should degrade gracefully to Unavailable in rebar metrics output rather than causing hard failures.
The Python analyzer lizard (1.23.0) is already pinned in uv.lock and transitively pulled by the dev extra, making the Makefile change behavior-preserving but necessary for intent clarity.
Documentation in docs/local-dev-env.md must mark scc and jscpd as optional and explain the degradation behavior when they are absent from PATH.
